# T-2: Implement plugin package lifecycle

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add repo management, candidate discovery, install, list, enable, disable, update-all, and sync behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Repo add/update/list and plugin find read checked-out plugin.json files.
- Install/sync copies only validated files and records commit state.
- Update advances all enabled packages only, with at most 200 enabled packages processed per invocation.
- Local path sources must be clean Git repositories/worktrees with resolvable HEAD commits.

## Implementation Notes
Use dedicated classes for repo sources, package manifests, contributions, install plans, and runtime package entries. Reject non-Git or dirty local paths before writing plugin.packages commit. Candidate discovery inspects at most 200 plugin.json manifests per repo checkout.

## Test Strategy
Unit and e2e tests using local path plugin repos and minimal plugin.json fixtures.
